answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every identity to lock a refundable stake behind a verifiable delay function before bidding: when a gale of fresh accounts floods a market, each must burn real compute time, so a thousand sock puppets cost a thousand times the delay, not one copy-paste. A yarrow root of trust, a few independent auditors, samples completed work and publishes a plume of signed reputation receipts; bids with no receipt are priced out, and fake receipts are slashed from the shared stake. Attackers may enter, but only by paying the same time and stake as honest agents.
